# Stationery

Pure-Ruby **PDF** documents built from *components*. See the [docs](https://example.test/docs).

## Install

```
gem "stationery"
```

## Features

- Paragraphs, headings and lists
- Tables:
  1. with headers
  2. with `aligned` cells

> Quotes work too.

| Element | Status |
|---|:-:|
| html | done |
